# Megabyte OS

> The AI operating system for Megabyte Labs — agent chat with company context, private self-building Gadget apps, and Gatekeeper security, running entirely on Cloudflare.

Megabyte OS is Megabyte Labs' private deployment of Cloudflare OS: an agent workspace where documents write themselves, apps grow their own features, and every agent action is guarded, logged, and owner-approved. It runs on Megabyte Labs' own Cloudflare account — no SaaS middleman, no data leaving home.

## What it does

- **Agent chat with context** — agents are preloaded with how Megabyte Labs operates (context, tools, and rules), so you ask for work, not files.
- **Gadgets** — self-building private apps (slide decks, dashboards, tools); each person gets their own safe, remixable copy, and you can ask the agent to add a feature.
- **Gatekeepers** — capability-scoped access to GitHub, Google, email and more; side-effects are simulated ahead and approved in bulk, with a full audit log.
- **Blueprints** — prompt to product: one sentence becomes a working app.
- **Scheduler** — agents run on timers and recurrences; research and reports arrive finished.
